top_strength: Jules masterfully gathered all logistics details, provided a personalized two-move estimate with accurate day-of-week pricing comparisons, and closed the sale by securing commitment on both move dates without requiring a deposit.
coaching_note: After the customer raised concerns about theft and damage from previous moves, Jules never asked a second follow-up layer ('tell me more about that') to understand the depth of the concern — he pivoted instead to praising the company's reputation, missing the opportunity to reinforce the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) that directly addressed what the customer said mattered most.
